US charges Bishnoi gang members in Nijjar killing, global crackdown announced

US prosecutors have charged jailed Indian gangster Lawrence Bishnoi and an associate with ordering the 2023 killing of Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Canada. The charges were announced alongside a global law enforcement operation targeting the Bishnoi gang, resulting in multiple arrests and raids. This development has significant implications for international relations and organized crime investigations.
